req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task update endpoint should ignore any changes to the task ID in the request body and only update the task identified by the URL. This ensures data integrity by preventing accidental or malicious changes to task identifiers.

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change_positive
preconditions: Task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update task with ID 1, including an incorrect ID in the request body.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated successfully.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Update task with ID 1, but include a different ID in the body
response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={
        "id": 999,  # Incorrect ID
        "title": "Updated Title",
        "description": "Updated Description",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["id"] == 1
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Title"
assert response.json()["description"] == "Updated Description"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change_negative
preconditions: Task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update task with ID 1, including an invalid ID in the request body.
expected: The task with ID 1 is not updated with the invalid ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update task with ID 1, but include an invalid ID in the body
response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={
        "id": "invalid",  # Invalid ID
        "title": "Updated Title",
        "description": "Updated Description",
        "completed": true
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["id"] == 1
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Title"
assert response.json()["description"] == "Updated Description"
assert response.json()["completed"] is True
